message: In the 48-volt Lithium Iron Phosphate battery bank (Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4), long-life lithium chemistry) (C3), Manager, the added door-opening load has closure risk for autonomy. To check it I used hand addition reusing the batch infiltration estimate (E15) with Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electricity) 2.5 to form the updated daily load calc (E16). I found 6.048 kilowatt-hours per day electric, according to American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers (ASHRAE, refrigeration authority), 2022 for thermal and Azzouz and co-workers, 2020 for COP. I propose retain 48-volt about 240 ampere-hour bank near 11.25 kilowatt-hours giving 1.49 days usable in the autonomy check (E17). My position: not ready because cloudy refill still gaps. In the tilted-roof Photovoltaic array (Photovoltaic (PV), sunlight-to-electricity panels) (C2), Maya, the two-day low-sun refill has energy deficit problem. To check it I used standard off-grid derate with Peak Sun Hours (PSH, equivalent hours at 1000 watts per square metre) to form the low-sun daily energy calc (E18). I found 3.75 kilowatt-hours per day from 2 kilowatts at 2 PSH with 25 percent losses versus 6.05 kilowatt-hours load, according to DIY Eco Homes, 2024. I propose upsize to 4 kilowatt tilted south roof PV with Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT, electronics holding panels at peak power) to break even on cloudy days plus ice-bank for nights. My position: not ready because I must resize structure and cost with you before ready.
